svg.title: Two exact fronts in a coupled first-order system
svg.desc: The time interval is zero to two. The position range is minus two to two. The affine plotting map is X equals 110 plus 340 t, Y equals 290 minus 100 x. The upper front is x equals t and the lower front is x equals minus t. The first component is minus beta over two between the fronts. The second component is a delta on the lower front. This is the section xi equals one; both nonzero covector directions occur.
svg.text: Two fronts from an exactly solved system
u₁ = −β/2 inside the interval; u₂ = δ(x+t); β ≠ 0

g.text: x = −t: jump of u₁ and delta of u₂
Exact model: a(ξ) = iξ diag(1,−1) + β [[0,1],[0,0]], with initial value (0,δ₀).
Proof: Section 5.3, equations (SY36)–(SY40). The interior is smooth; only its two boundaries are singular.
Spacetime section on 0 ≤ t ≤ 2. Independently constructed from the displayed exact solution.
